observerContract: Detached diagnostics only; tolerances, perturbations, line search, method and heat transfer unchanged.

propertyResolution.interpretation: Quantization is measured within the same table, not direct-EOS interpolation error. Converged closures do meet 1e-12 K, but failed attempts show it is not achieved consistently at proposed larger steps; no tolerance remedy was adopted.

failedHistory.format: Concatenated gzip JSONL members; complete events for every failed Newton attempt

timingCaution: Sequential representative runs on one shared worker; wall times are not controlled hardware benchmarks. Observer includes archive serialization/IO. State/traces/counters are exactly identical for candidate, corrected and observed runs.
